screening_decisions.reason: Methodological study about unpublished rating scales and bias in schizophrenia trials. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
Systematic review comparing second-generation vs first-generation antipsychotics for TD risk. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Pharmacokinetics study examining haloperidol serum concentrations. Not about benzodiazepines for TD treatment.
Animal study (monkeys) examining GABA synthesis in neuroleptic-induced dyskinesia. Not a human RCT.

24-week crossover design study testing diazepam (benzodiazepine) in 13 subjects with tardive dyskinesia. Assessed TD and psychopathology with blind raters. Meets criteria for benzodiazepine intervention for TD treatment.
Review article updating TD rates with first vs second generation antipsychotics. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Review article on extrapyramidal symptoms with atypical antipsychotics. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD.
Methodological study linking BPRS to CGI ratings. Not an intervention study for TD.
Educational review about benzodiazepine use in psychiatric practice. Not an RCT for TD treatment.
Review of incidence studies of TD with typical antipsychotics. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Statistical methods note about cluster randomized trials. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Observational study of TD improvement after neuroleptic discontinuation. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Methodological discussion of therapeutic efficacy indices. Not a clinical trial.
Description of the Brief Psychiatric Rating Scale instrument. Not an intervention study.
Review article about atypical antipsychotics and drug-induced movement disorders. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
General review about benzodiazepine use, abuse, and dependence. Not an RCT for TD treatment.
Cochrane review of NON-benzodiazepine GABA agonists (baclofen, valproate, etc.) for TD. Explicitly excludes benzodiazepines.
Statistical methods paper about detecting skewness. Not a clinical trial.
General discussion about clinical research for schizophrenia treatment. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines for TD.
Cochrane review of calcium channel blockers for TD. Not about benzodiazepines.
Methodological study about PANSS score interpretation. Not an intervention study for TD.
Systematic review and meta-analysis comparing TD risk with first vs second generation antipsychotics. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
RCT comparing haloperidol dosing regimens in acute schizophrenia. Not about TD treatment with benzodiazepines.
Comparative study of two benzodiazepines (diazepam vs nitrazepam) in 20 patients with postneuroleptic tardive dyskinesia. Both drugs tested as therapeutic modalities for TD treatment.
Controlled study of clonazepam (benzodiazepine) versus phenobarbital in 21 psychiatric patients with tardive dyskinesia. Clonazepam significantly reduced dyskinetic movements.
Single-dose challenge study of multiple agents including diazepam. Not a proper RCT design for TD treatment evaluation.
Cochrane review of Vitamin E for TD. Not about benzodiazepines.
Observational cohort study of mortality rates in schizophrenia patients with TD. Not an RCT.
Cochrane review of cholinergic medications for TD. Not about benzodiazepines.
Cochrane review of catecholaminergic drugs for TD. Not about benzodiazepines.
RCT testing tetrabenazine with diazepam as control. Primary intervention is tetrabenazine, not benzodiazepine.
Animal study (rats) about Purkinje cell growth in GVHD. Title misleading - not about human TD treatment with diazepam.
RCT testing naltrexone alone and with clonazepam. Primary intervention is naltrexone, clonazepam is adjunctive/subtherapeutic.
Naturalistic prospective study comparing course of schizophrenia with vs without TD. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Review article about therapeutic options for TD. Mentions clonazepam but is not an RCT.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized crossover trial of clonazepam (benzodiazepine) in 19 chronically ill patients with tardive dyskinesia. Found 35% decrease in dyskinesia ratings with clonazepam.
ABA' single-subject design study of diazepam. Not a traditional RCT design.
Methodological paper about detecting bias in meta-analyses using funnel plots. Not a clinical trial.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis of cluster randomized trials. Not a clinical trial.
General review article about tardive dyskinesia. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
Methodological paper about meta-analyses involving cross-over trials. Not a clinical trial.
RCT testing benztropine and propranolol for tardive AKATHISIA (not TD). Different condition.
Incomplete abstract - methodological paper about measuring inconsistency in meta-analyses.
ABA' single-subject design study of diazepam. Not a traditional RCT design.
Methodological paper about variance components and ICCs for survey design. Not a clinical trial.
Methodological study about CONSORT statement impact on RCT reporting quality. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Discussion of TD incidence with atypical antipsychotics (olanzapine vs haloperidol). Not about benzodiazepines.
Methodological paper about attrition in RCTs. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Systematic review of methods for evaluating cluster-based interventions. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Review article about free radical involvement in neuroleptic-induced movement disorders. Not an RCT.
Methodological paper about assessing quality of controlled trials. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Methodological study about unit of analysis error in physician behavior studies. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Methodological paper about imputing missing standard deviations in meta-analyses. Not a clinical trial for TD.
Longitudinal observational study of TD and parkinsonism course over 14 years. Not an RCT testing benzodiazepines.
